#region function Update-NetworkDriveMap
# This is just a function that's needed later on to prevent all kinds of code duplication and complexity
# in the main part of the script
function Update-NetworkDriveMap {
	[CmdletBinding()]
	param (
		# Drive Letter
		[Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
		[string]$driveLetter,

		# URI to required destination
		[Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
		[string]$shareURI
	)
	
	begin {
		[string]$localPath = "${driveLetter}:"
        Try {
            $currentMapping = Get-SmbMapping -LocalPath $localPath -ErrorAction Stop
        }
        Catch {
            [string]$currentMapping = 'NA'
        }
	}
	
	process {
        $currentMapping

        # If there is a mapping already but it doesn't match we need to remove it
        If ( ($currentMapping -ne 'NA') -and ($currentMapping.RemotePath -ne $shareURI) ) {
			# Remove current drive mapping
            #write-output "Removing [${driveLetter}] drive mapping to [$($currentMapping.RemotePath)]"
            #Write-Verbose -Message "Removing [${driveLetter}] drive mapping to [$($currentMapping.RemotePath)]"
			Start-Process -FilePath 'net.exe' -ArgumentList 'use',$localPath,'/delete' -WindowStyle Hidden
        }
        
        # Only remap the correct share if it's needed
        If ( ($currentMapping -eq 'NA') -or ($currentMapping.RemotePath -ne $shareURI) ) {
            # Create new, correct drive mapping
            #write-output "Creating mapping of [${driveLetter}] to [${shareURI}]"
            #write-output $localPath
            #write-output $shareURI
            Write-Verbose -Message "Creating mapping of [${driveLetter}] to [${shareURI}]"
            $shareURIFixed = ("`"" + $shareURI + "`"")
            Start-Process -FilePath 'net.exe' -ArgumentList 'use',$localPath,$shareURIFixed -WindowStyle Hidden
        }
	}
}

#endregion

                            $drivesList.Add('T',$driveMaps['T'])

                            $drivesList.Add('V',$driveMaps['V'])
                            $drivesList.Add('W',$driveMaps['W'])
                            $drivesList.Add('UO',$driveMaps['UO']) }
        }

      # Just add a few more common mappings if this isn't a special group
      #If ( -not($groupMatches) ) 
      #  {
      #    $drivesList.Add('V',$driveMaps['V'])
      #    $drivesList.Add('W',$driveMaps['W'])
      #    $drivesList.Add('U',$driveMaps['U'])
      #  }
    }
    
    # Turn Off Persistence
    Start-Process -FilePath 'net.exe' -ArgumentList 'use','/PERSISTENT:NO' -WindowStyle Hidden

    # Now actually map the drives after getting rid of any duplicates
   ForEach ($drive in $drivesList.Keys) 
     {
       #write-output ($drive + " : " + $driveslist[$drive])
       # iterate through the list of drive letters to map
       # Fix the fact that Office U: and regular U: are not the same mapping
       If ($drive -eq 'UO') {$correctLetter = 'U'} Else {$correctLetter = $drive}

       # Now call the function to fix the drive letters
       Update-NetworkDriveMap -driveLetter $correctLetter -shareURI $driveslist[$drive]
     }

   # Turn On Persistence
    Start-Process -FilePath 'net.exe' -ArgumentList 'use','/PERSISTENT:YES' -WindowStyle Hidden

$ScriptEndTime = Get-Date
[string]$ScriptTimeTaken = ($ScriptEndTime.Subtract($ScriptStartTime) | select totalmilliseconds)
#===Log===
[string]$message = $ScriptTimeTaken
write-eventlog -logname "LogonScript" -source “LogonScript” -entrytype Information -eventid 4 -message $message
#=========


#}
#endregion

strInAd = "Yes"

If InStr(strComputerName, "GHOST") Then

	intCommaPosition = InStr(strComputerName, ",")

	'WScript.Echo strCN
	
	strComputer = Right (strCN, (Len(strCN) - 3))
	'WScript.Echo strComputer
	
	strOU = Left (strComputer, 4)
	'WScript.Echo strOU

		strServer = "5000M31"

		set objCommand = CreateObject("ADODB.Command")
		objCommand.ActiveConnection = objConnection
		
		objCommand.CommandText = "<LDAP://" & strLDAPContext & ">;(&(objectCategory=organizationalUnit));distinguishedName,name;onelevel"
		
		set objRecordSet = objCommand.Execute
		
		While Not objRecordSet.EOF
			If objRecordSet.Fields("name") = strOU Then
				strInAd = "Yes"
			End If
			objRecordSet.MoveNext
		Wend
		
		objConnection.Close
	End If
'	WScript.Echo "Server: " & strServer

Else
'	WScript.Echo "Not a Ghost Server"
	intCommaPosition = InStr(strComputerName, ",")
	'WScript.Echo intCommaPosition
	
	strContext = Right(strComputerName, (Len(strComputerName) - intCommaPosition))

	set objConnection = CreateObject("ADODB.Connection")
	objConnection.Open "Provider=ADsDSOObject;"
	
	set objCommand = CreateObject("ADODB.Command")
	objCommand.ActiveConnection = objConnection
	
	objCommand.CommandText = "<LDAP://" & strContext & ">;(&(objectCategory=computer));distinguishedName,name;onelevel"
	
	set objRecordSet = objCommand.Execute
	
	While Not objRecordSet.EOF
		strDistinguishedName = objRecordSet.Fields("distinguishedName")
		If strDistinguishedName = strComputerName Then
'			WScript.Echo strComputerName & " has been found."
			strOkay = InStr (strComputerName, ",OU=Schools,DC=tvnet,DC=Pri")

--- \\tvnet.pri\NETLOGON\WUSRepairScript.vbs ---
\\tvnet.pri\NETLOGON\WUSRepairScript.vbs                           1880 2006-09-27 10:25:47 AM
'This script is used to repair problems when cloneing workstations and is designed to be run in a Group Policy environment. 
'It pulls the computer name from the registry and compares it to a set flag. 
'If they're different, the script will add the new system to WSUS. 
'........................................

Set oShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")

sRegKey = "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WindowsUpdate"
sNameKey = "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\ComputerName\ActiveComputerName"

' suppress error in case values does not exist
On Error Resume Next

' check for marker
sIDDeleted = oShell.RegRead( sRegKey & "\IDDeleted")
sIDSystemName = oShell.RegRead( sRegKey & "\IDSystemName")
sComputerName = oShell.RegRead( sNameKey & "\ComputerName")

'WScript.Echo sIDDeleted
'WScript.Echo sIDSystemName & " : " & sComputerName

' to be sure values is only deleted once, test on marker
If (sIDSystemName <> sComputerName) or (sIDDeleted <> "yes") Then
'	WScript.Echo "Fixing"

	'Stop Automatic Update Service
	oShell.Run "%SystemRoot%\system32\net.exe stop wuauserv", 0, True
'	WScript.Echo "Service Stopped"

	'Delete Values
	oShell.RegDelete sRegKey & "\AccountDomainSid"
	oShell.RegDelete sRegKey & "\PingID"
	oShell.RegDelete sRegKey & "\SusClientId"

	'Create Marker
	oShell.RegWrite sRegKey & "\IDDeleted", "yes"
	oShell.RegWrite sRegKey & "\IDSystemName", sComputerName
	
	'Start Automatic Update Service
	oShell.Run "%SystemRoot%\system32\net.exe start wuauserv", 0, True
'	WScript.Echo "Service Started"
	
	'Reauthorize Windows Automatic Update Client
	sCmd = "%SystemRoot%\system32\wuauclt.exe /resetauthorization /detectnow"
	oShell.Run sCmd, 0, True
'	WScript.Echo "ReAuthorized"
	
End If

'--------------------------------------------

'WScript.Echo "Done"
WScript.Quit

'Script Name:		CCMCheck_NoLogging.vbs
'Designed by:		
'Date Created:		June 23, 2004
'Script Purpose:	This startup script checks to see if the SMS Client service
'			is present on the workstations and if not tries to install it.  

DIM strComputer

CONST OverWriteExisting = True
CONST WaitForReturn = True
CONST Hidden = 0
Const EVENT_SUCCESS = 0
Const Timeout = 4
Const PopupTitle = "SMS Client Install Script"

On error Resume Next

Set objShell = WScript.CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set objFSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")

Set colSystemVars = objShell.Environment("Process")
strWindowsDirectory = colSystemVars("SYSTEMROOT") 

strComputer = "."

'Perform a SQL Count on CLISVC and then check the count
Set objWMIService = GetObject _
("winmgmts:" & "{impersonationLevel=impersonate}!\\" & strComputer & "\root\cimv2")

Set colRunningServices = objWMIService.ExecQuery _
("Select * from Win32_Service where name = 'ccmexec'")
If colRunningServices.count = 0 then
	If objFSO.FileExists(strWindowsDirectory & "\temp\ccmsetup.exe") Then
		objShell.Popup "The SMS Client Service is being installed on this workstation...", Timeout, PopupTitle, vbInformation
		objShell.Run "%windir%\temp\ccmsetup.exe /service smssitecode=AUTO"
		wscript.sleep 30000	
	Else
		objShell.Popup "The SMS Client is NOT installed." & VbCrLf & "The Install File is Missing.", Timeout, PopupTitle, vbInfomation
	End If	

Else
'	objShell.Popup "The SMS Client Service is already running on the workstation!", Timeout, PopupTitle, vbInformation
'	wscript.echo "The SMS Client Service is already running on the workstation!"
	

End if

objShell.Popup "Done.", Timeout, PopupTitle, vbInformation


SET objWMIService = NOTHING
SET colRunningServices = NOTHING
SET objSHell = NOTHING

strComputer="."

  '%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

  Set objFSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")

  '$$$$ Wait for File $$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$
  Const CUPROFILE = &H28&
  Set objShellz = CreateObject("Shell.Application")

  Set objFolderItemz = objFolderz.Self

  Do Until strIsThere = "YES"
    If objFSO.FileExists("" & strPathz & "\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Windows\appsFolder.itemdata-ms")Then
      strIsThere = "YES"
    Else
      WScript.Sleep 5000
    End If
  Loop

        Else
            str5000Group = "YES"
        End If
      End If
      '!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
      
      If InStr (UCase(Group), UCase("Teachers Group")) or InStr (UCase(Group), UCase("Office Group")) or InStr (UCase(Group), UCase("TSA  Group")) Then
